metadata.question: Between October 2021 and November 2021, did southern Ethiopia receive less rainfall than northern Ethiopia relative its long-term average for the same months from 2000 to 2013?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall patterns in Ethiopia, specifically comparing southern vs northern regions during October-November 2021 relative to their long-term averages from 2000-2013. I need to: 1. Use precipitation data - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) would be appropriate 2. Define two regions: northern Ethiopia and southern Ethiopia 3. Calculate rainfall for Oct-Nov 2021 in both regions 4. Calculate long-term average (2000-2013) for same months in both regions 5. Compute anomalies (2021 value / long-term average) and compare 6. If southern anomaly < northern anomaly, answer "A: Yes", else "B: No" Data strategy: - Use CHIRPS daily precipitation: "UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY" - Band: 'precipitation' - Regions: Define polygons for northern and southern Ethiopia - Time periods: Oct-Nov 2021 vs Oct-Nov 2000-2013 (long-term) Processing: - Sum precipitation for each period/region - Calculate anomaly ratio - Compare anomalies Validation: - Check collection sizes - Check pixel counts after processing - Validate results are reasonable (positive precipitation values) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define regions for northern and southern Ethiopia const northEthiopia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[37.5, 14.5], [42.0, 14.5], [42.0, 12.0], [37.5, 12.0], [37.5, 14.5]] ]); const southEthiopia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[35.0, 8.0], [42.0, 8.0], [42.0, 4.0], [35.0, 4.0], [35.0, 8.0]] ]); // Load CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // Function to calculate total precipitation for a given period and region function calculatePrecipitation(startDate, endDate, region) { const collection = chirps .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); if (collection.size().getInfo() === 0) { return null; } const totalPrecip = collection.sum(); // Calculate valid pixel count const count = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); if (count === 0) { return null; } const meanPrecip = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); return {mean: meanPrecip, count: count}; } // Calculate 2021 precipitation (Oct-Nov) const precip2021North = calculatePrecipitation('2021-10-01', '2021-11-30', northEthiopia); const precip2021South = calculatePrecipitation('2021-10-01', '2021-11-30', southEthiopia); // Calculate long-term average (2000-2013, Oct-Nov) let longtermNorth = 0; let longtermSouth = 0; let validYears = 0; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2013; year++) { const period = `${year}-10-01`; const north = calculatePrecipitation(period, `${year}-11-30`, northEthiopia); const south = calculatePrecipitation(period, `${year}-11-30`, southEthiopia); if (north && south) { longtermNorth += north.mean; longtermSouth += south.mean; validYears++; } } // Check for data availability if (!precip2021North || !precip2021South || validYears === 0) { if (validYears === 0) { console.log("No valid long-term data found"); console.log("C1"); } else if (!precip2021North || !precip2021South) { console.log("2021 data missing for one or both regions"); console.log("C1"); } return; } // Calculate long-term averages longtermNorth /= validYears; longtermSouth /= validYears; // Calculate anomalies (2021 / long-term average) const anomalyNorth = precip2021North.mean / longtermNorth; const anomalySouth = precip2021South.mean / longtermSouth; // Validate results if (isNaN(anomalyNorth) || isNaN(anomalySouth) || anomalyNorth <= 0 || anomalySouth <= 0 || anomalyNorth > 10 || anomalySouth > 10) { console.log(`Invalid anomaly values: North=${anomalyNorth.toFixed(3)}, South=${anomalySouth.toFixed(3)}`); console.log("C3"); return; } // Print stats console.log(`2021 North: ${precip2021North.mean.toFixed(1)}mm (${precip2021North.count} pixels)`); console.log(`2021 South: ${precip2021South.mean.toFixed(1)}mm (${precip2021South.count} pixels)`); console.log(`Long-term North: ${longtermNorth.toFixed(1)}mm`); console.log(`Long-term South: ${longtermSouth.toFixed(1)}mm`); console.log(`North Anomaly: ${anomalyNorth.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`South Anomaly: ${anomalySouth.toFixed(3)}`); // Determine answer if (anomalySouth < anomalyNorth) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
